purpose: Purpose Menthol Topical Analgesic Methyl Salicylate Topical Analgesic
uses: Uses For the temporary relief of minor aches and pains of muscles and joints associated with arthritis, simple backache, strains, sprains, bruises
otcwarn: Stop Use and Ask a Doctor If condition worsens. redness is present. irritation develops. symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days.
